name: Chaos Orb
description: The chaos origin before the birth of the Land of Dawn, capable of reforging the world.

name: Eternal Talisman
description: A legendary jade talisman commanding the rules of life and death, capable of absorbing and releasing life force at will.

name: Celebration Cake
description: A cake left over from a grand event, carrying beautiful memories.

name: Dark Scale Dragon Robe
description: Forged from a reverse scale shed by a black dragon. The wearer can withstand devastating magic and unconsciously radiates the overwhelming presence of a true dragon, compelling all beasts to submit.

name: Great Dragon Spear
description: The supreme treasure of the Dragon Altar passes down not just power, but also responsibility. For the Cadia Riverlands and for us, its flame is passed on, burning endlessly.

name: Time Potion
description: Boasts the powerful effect of reversing time and making one young again. It is a beloved collection of a certain time scientist.

name: Spacetime Core
description: A mythic core that maintains the temporal stability of Land of Dawn. Each core left outside spells the loss of a continent.

name: Dawnbreak Aegis
description: The shield is forged from pure Sunstone. When fully activated, its light can dispel the night, just like the sun rising at dawn.

name: Realmbreaker Axe
description: This legendary weapon wields the power to cleave through dimensional barriers, let alone ordinary foes.

name: Dawn Origin Crystal
description: The legendary origin vein of the Land of Dawn, possessing the origin power of the earth.

name: Firmament Bow
description: A legendary bow capable of shooting down any star. Almost no one can wield it.

name: Origin Armor
description: Armor forged with the primal power of the earth, capable of absorbing most incoming attacks.

name: Dew of Foresight
description: Distilled from tears, it unveils a future calamity within dreams, but permanently erases a cherished memory.

name: Holy Core
description: A fragment of the Holy Light God's core, granting sacred and immortal power.

name: Annihilation Blade
description: A demonic blade corrupted by both shadow and the Abyss, eroding the minds of all who attempt to wield it, until they become a world-ending demon lord.

name: Sacred Beast Pendant
description: A carved Sacred Beast filled with the power of lightning, defending the empire's territory.

name: Bane's Ship in a Bottle
description: A ship in a bottle modeled after a warship captured by Bane. Rumor has it that these are real warships sealed inside bottles by magic.

name: Thunder Core
description: A material containing great thunder power, essential for crafting top-tier lightning Equipment.

name: X.Borg Armor
description: Spare armor resold by X.Borg. Due to a momentary distraction during its creation, a safety device was added that prevents it from self-destructing. X.Borg considers it a failure, much like the people of Eruditio.

name: Mechanical Divine Heart
description: The heart of a powerful creature in the steam mechanical world, which can be used as the core power source for mechanical devices.

name: Malefic Gun
description: Technology from Eruditio. It boasts a longer range, stronger momentum, and massive firepower! Just like that sweet-smiling, passionate, and radiant girl.

name: Star-Core Jar
description: A large bottle crafted with Star-Core magic. It collects not only fragments of the wanderer's homeland, but also the stories of his journey.

name: Dragon Jade
description: The immortal jade of the Eastern Realms glowing with dragon runes, containing fragments of supreme immortal mysteries.

name: Shadow Avatar
description: A body fragment of a high-tier creature in the shadow world, immune to all Physical ATK.

name: Eternal Ice Crystal
description: Condensed divine power of the Maiden of the Glacier. When used, it freezes the body, granting immunity to fatal strikes and restoring vitality.

name: Eternal Chalice
description: A legendary mythic relic that grants living beings the power of immortality.

name: Great Dragon Pill
description: The Moon Rabbit's favorite snack. Legend has it that it's an expensive elixir from the Dragon Altar.

name: Angela's Doll
description: A legendary doll said to possess protective power, automatically attaching itself to those in mortal danger.

name: Shendu Pastry
description: A royal pastry of Shendu. Consuming it grants the protection of the Cadia Riverlands.

name: Meteorite Core
description: Said to be the remnant of a destroyed star, capable of forging treasures that transcend dimensions.

name: War Axe
description: This battle axe once accompanied the Leonin ancestors and Elves in defending against the Abyss, now lying dormant after exhausting its power.

name: Heart of the Abyss
description: The core of the Shadow Abyss, commanding all shadow and chaos power.

name: Stargate Elixir
description: Where in the world will you be transported to after drinking this elixir from the temporal rift?

name: Chaos Stone
description: Contains both the power of order and chaos, able to absorb any matter it touches.

name: Soulbloom Umbrella
description: Cherry Witch's exclusive umbrella, which can be used to cast spells against enemies in addition to providing shade.

name: Phantom Armor
description: An heirloom passed down through House Paxley. It has the ability to distort light, making the wearer completely invisible even in sunlight.

name: Holy Shield
description: Standard shield of the Light's Order, wards off the evil corruption of the abyss.

name: Abyssal Essence
description: The primal essence of the deep sea, a single fragment enough to turn an ordinary person into a master of water.

name: Moon Cone
description: A carefully decorated chocolate cone. Legend has it that whoever sits on it can travel to the moon.

name: Omni Soulstone
description: A mythic stone condensing the souls of all living beings in the Land of Dawn.

name: Abyssal Crown
description: The mermaid queen's exclusive crown, controls all the power of the tides in the deep sea.

name: Romantic Fountain
description: The fountain has recorded the sweet love of countless couples.

name: Sunflare Core
description: The core left behind after the fall of the sun deity, capable of incinerating all darkness.

name: Mystic Dragon Reishi
description: A ten-thousand-year reishi that has endured the Black Dragon's Sha Residue in the Dragon Altar. It possesses infinite vitality.

name: Raging Scythe
description: When this scythe turns its rage upon you, you feel nothing but fear.

name: Divine Crossbow
description: A hand crossbow forged from mithril, engraved with golden lightning patterns, each shot imbued with the power of thunder to destroy creatures of darkness.

name: Dark System
description: This dark matter sphere suspended deep in the universe is hated by many. Some have been trying to erase it, but without success.

name: Strange Fruit
description: Grows deep in the Shadow Swamp. Eating it helps the Leonin control their power more easily.

name: Raging Cloak
description: Guess whether it's the cute Little Red Hood beneath the cloak... or your end.

name: Tai Chi Stone
description: Possesses the miracle power of creation and can manifest any power in the world.

name: Savage Beast Bone
description: Contains the bloodline of ancient wild beasts and the power of wildness.

name: Tharz
description: Be careful not to be swallowed whole by Tharz.

name: Knight's Soul
description: The battle soul of the first-generation of Light's Order, possessing world-destroying power.

name: Thunder Hammer
description: A war hammer shining with thunder power, summons heavenly thunder to purify all things.

name: Dark Elixir
description: Resurrects a recently deceased creature as a corrupted Abyssal Devil.

name: Holy Dew
description: A rare potion from the Monastery of Light, heals all non-fatal injuries.

name: Windtalk Robe
description: More like a fluttering ribbon than a robe, offering little in the way of defense, but amplifying wind magic tremendously.

name: Nether Flower
description: For the fighters of the Barren Lands, approaching the abyss is the best way to increase their power.

name: Fruit of Hope
description: An autumn fruit from the Forest of Hope, picked by Floryn, imbued with the magical essence of three seasons.

name: Great Dragon Scale
description: Scales bearing the power of dragon, said to have been left on the battlefield by the wounded Great Dragon.

name: Deer Spirit Statue
description: Carved based on the deer spirit of the Gloomy Forest, perhaps carrying the blessing of the moonlight.

name: Eye of the Void Sea
description: A gem from a scholar's weapon. It can pierce through illusions and travel between planes.

name: Fighter's Sash
description: A beloved item of a martial artist, accompanying him through countless combats. A proof of honor.

name: Heart of Frost
description: The core of the far north's ley lines, condensing the power of the frost domain. It can freeze all surrounding enemies.

name: Anti-Magic Stone
description: Magic is disdained by this stone, and any flow of mana is suppressed.

name: Abyssal Scale Armor
description: A gift from the sea beast to human allies, crafted from the scales of the Deep Sea Lord's neck, granting protection to the wearer underwater.

name: Nunchaku
description: The martial artist usually relies solely on his fists and feet. It seems no one is worthy of the Nunchaku on his back.

name: Eclipsed Nectar
description: Dark Elves collect the pure energy left by flowers in the Shadow Swamp, brewing a drink that contains the original shadow power.

name: Dragonblood Potion
description: A rare potion made from dragon blood. Consuming it can greatly increase all attributes.

name: Primal Dragon Stone
description: A gem fiercely contested by the Black Dragon and the White Dragon. You can absorb ancient bloodline power from it.

name: Thread of Fate
description: Anyone connected to it will become her puppet on a string.

name: Ace of Hearts
description: A magic poker card. Beneath a sky filled with Ace of Hearts, the figure of magician Harley has long disappeared.

name: Mirror Mask
description: A wondrous mask that reflects the viewer's heart. When worn, its appearance shifts during interaction with others, taking on the form most recognized by the observer.

name: Autobot Shield
description: A giant shield carried by the Autobot, which not only absorbs frontal DMG but also emits Electromagnetic Waves to attack.

name: Revival Potion
description: A miraculous medicine capable of curing illnesses and even regenerating lost limbs. Yet it is still not the remedy Faramis seeks—the one that could make the hearts of the undead beat once more.

name: Rune Armor
description: Heavy armor forged from fine iron, engraved with Eruditio's rune circuits. It grants immunity to most control effects.

name: Malefic Energy Pastry
description: A pastry infused with the Starlium Power, the favorite of a certain mechanical creature.

name: Flaming Heart
description: The origin core taken from an active volcano. It can unleash raging fire that burns everything.

name: Magician Hat
description: Magician Harley's legendary hat. The spatial power within allows the user to travel back and forth between different areas.

name: Yin-Yang Pill
description: Refined from a mysterious elixir formula originating in Cadia Riverlands, it is imbued with restorative power born of the balance of Yin and Yang.

name: Realmbreaker Blade
description: An indestructible legendary blade that can rupture spatial barriers.

name: Mirror Device
description: A mysterious six-sided dice. It is said to have the power of duplication when activated with magic.

name: Book of Knowledge
description: Diggie's book of daily use, blending mechanical and magical power.

name: Runebound Thunder Hammer
description: A rune war hammer infused with thunder power. Its golden runes erupt with wild thunder upon ATK.

name: Darknight Fruit
description: An apple filled with the shadow power. Consuming it provides endless magic power.

name: Exorcist's Seal
description: Exorcists gain power from this seal.

name: Sacred Pearl
description: A sacred pearl guarded by the seafolk across generations, containing boundless oceanic power capable of summoning tidal waves.

name: Yoyo
description: How did the magical companion turn into a yo-yo?

name: Crispy Chip
description: A little sand fox's favorite item. Eating it provides a slight sense of fullness.

name: Divine Blossom Chalcedony
description: Contains the primal power of the sacred sakura tree from the Scarlet Shadow. Ninja tools forged with it can pierce through enemies.

name: Shadow Scale Armor
description: Scale armor forged from the energy essence of shadow monsters. It automatically absorbs nearby light, concealing the wearer's figure.

name: Champion Boxing Glove
description: Said to be the gloves of a boxing champion, bearing the marks of rigorous training.

name: Moonlight Mithril
description: A pure mithril ore that has absorbed moonlight for centuries. Weapons forged from it are more lethal against Abyssal Devils.

name: Essence Core
description: A lustrous pearl inlaid into Luo Yi's whisk, imbued with essence.

name: Starcore Gem
description: The Heart Gem of the Celestial Realms, which governs the fundamental laws of time and space.

name: Holy Boots
description: A component of the Holy Armor that has existed since the founding of Light's Order. Under its sacred radiance, shadow creatures cannot hide.

name: Tree of Life Sap
description: The sap of the Tree of Life in the Emerald Woodland that nurtures the Moon Elf King. It possesses extremely strong vitality.

name: Mushroom Soup
description: A thick soup made from mushrooms of the Shadow Swamp, capable of nourishing the bodies of dark creatures.

name: Silk of Fate
description: Condenses the oracles of the Stargate, able to follow the guidance of fate to avert disaster.

name: Primordial Mark
description: An energy core formed from shattered starlight. Golden light signifies beauty—and imminent destruction.

name: Shadow Mark Cloak
description: A cloak woven from a blend of special fibers and magical beast hair. Its inner lining is inscribed with an anti-magic array, capable of reducing the effects of spells when directly hit.

name: Celestial Orb
description: Starsoul Magician's exclusive magic orb, manipulates the power of dawn and deep night.

name: Scholar's Aviator Hat
description: The hat of a time scientist, distinguished by its signature flight goggles and a flower that never withers.

name: Darkrock Jerky
description: Meat from an abyssal beast, defeated and roasted by Orcs over Darkrock, infused with vital energy.

name: Berserker Soul Stone
description: Sacred relic of the fighter legion, condenses the battle souls of thousands of fighters.

name: Nether Elixir
description: Having absorbed all energy left by the Mist, it is the ultimate medium for dark magic.

name: Time Gear
description: The core part from Diggie's alarm clock, breaks the barriers between magic and technology.

name: Playful Pinwheel
description: Which is cuter—the pinwheel or its owner?

name: Shadow Orb
description: An orb imbued with the power of shadows, capable of enhancing the wielder's affinity with shadows.

name: Spectral Blade
description: Karina's exclusive twin blades. The deep blue blades emit a dark aura, capable of devouring the souls of the living.

name: Shadow Crystal Core Cluster
description: The core cluster of the oldest Shadow Crystal vein deep within the Shadow Swamp, formed when dark power corrupted the forest during the Endless War.

name: Exorcism Orb
description: The more orbs an Exorcist possesses, the more souls reside around them.

name: Celestial Fragment
description: Shattered fragments from the Celestial Realms, containing stable spatial energy.

name: Colorful Conch
description: Conchs growing in the depths of the Vonetis Sea, with delicious meat.

name: Sacred Sand
description: Sand and gravel from ancient battlefields, imbued with the power of Einherjar. Adding them to any weapon makes it exceptionally hard.

name: Leonin Crystal
description: A gem containing the thunder power, it seems only the Leonin can master it.

name: Dragon Essence Fruit
description: The legendary divine tree growing in the Dragon Altar. The fruits it bears carry the power of the Great Dragon.

name: Legion Shield
description: A giant shield from the fighter legion. The double-axe emblem carved on its surface can boost the willpower of surrounding allies.

name: Ion Greatsword
description: A standard two-handed sword of a now-disbanded heavy infantry legion in Moniyan. It features a wide, heavy blade that favors crushing force over sharpness.

name: Lucky Cat
description: A gentle wave of the little hand brings in endless wealth.

name: Gilded Preserved Fruit
description: The special preserved fruit of the empire's nobility, luxurious and delicate.

name: Crystal Dagger
description: A short sword engraved with energy circuits. When fully charged, its sharp blade can easily cut through metal.

name: Soul Fire Necklace
description: A necklace imbued with a fragment of an Einherjar's battle soul, granting the wearer courage in the face of enemies.

name: Frenzy Potion
description: An advanced version of Power Potion. It can greatly stimulate the user's potential in a short time.

name: Orb of Light
description: An orb imbued with the power of light, capable of enhancing the wielder's affinity with light.

name: Gilded Champagne
description: A precious champagne with fine bubbles. Drinking it inspires the mind, provides a slight restoration of condition, and boosts morale.

name: Star Potion
description: A potion that amplifies magic power, providing long-lasting effects.

name: Ghostlight Mushroom
description: A spirit mushroom that grows deep in the forest at night. Consuming it clears the mind.

name: Sacred Sakura
description: Century-old cherry blossoms growing in the Scarlet Shadow Sect, possessing the power of souls.

name: Scarlet Shadow Sakura Mochi
description: Scarlet cherry blossoms that grow in the Land of Scarlet Shadow, imbued with the power of Ninjutsu.

name: Deep Sea Squid Ink
description: Can this thing really heal wounds?

name: Mecha Arm Armor
description: Arm guards forged with pure mechanical craftsmanship. They utilize mist power to unleash greater strength during an attack.

name: Holy Potion
description: A potion blessed by the holy light, quickly healing wounds.

name: Crystal Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe made of gold and crystal, but it seems it has never unearthed any treasure.

name: Dragon Eye Stone
description: A stone shaped like a dragon's eye. If you stare at it for too long, it gives you the illusion that the stone is blinking.

name: Moonstone
shape: Crescent moon shape, translucent, with a small inner crescent
description: A moon-shaped stone that continuously emits moonlight, making it the preferred material for the Elves' accessories.

name: Exorcism Dagger
shape: Dagger with bone hilt, skull decoration, runic inscriptions on the blade
description: Enhanced with exorcism runes, it can rupture low-level magic shields.

name: Mechanical Sacred Heart
shape: Mechanical heart with gears and pipes and small wings
description: The industrial core of a mechanical civilization. It can provide infinite energy to almost all ordinary factories.

name: Pearl of the Deep
shape: Large iridescent pearl sitting in a silver wave-like stand
description: Even in the lightless abyss, the pearl still shines.

name: Cloud Pattern Folding Fan
shape: Opened folding fan with gold and white cloud patterns
description: Valir's folding fan. Is there a handsome face behind it, or blazing flames?

name: Holy Breastplate
shape: Round shield/breastplate with a golden cross in the middle and small white wings on the sides
description: A breastplate blessed by an angel. It protects the wearer once when taking fatal damage.

name: Sacred Potion
shape: Heart-shaped flask containing purple liquid with a gold helmet emblem on it
description: The soul potion passed down in the Valhalla. Using it can heal the spirit.

name: Lotus Heart Pill
shape: A pink lotus flower inside a square wooden box
description: The lotus blooms and nurtures seeds. Consume them to receive the power of protection.

name: Spirit Fox Fur
shape: A coiled white fox fur/pelt with blue glowing eyes
description: Crafted from the pelt of a spirit fox, it provides warmth while concealing the wearer's presence. It is the favorite of a certain polar queen.

name: Soulbloom Jade
shape: Pink cherry blossom shaped jade pendant with a blue swirl in the center
description: A rare jade from the Eastern Realms, containing a trace of immortal power.

name: Emerald Pendant
shape: Golden pendant with a large green gem that looks like an eye
description: An emerald pendant worn by the sage, radiating magical power.

name: Dim Sapphire
description: A finely cut gemstone with multiple polished faces. After losing its magical power, it was set into the finest jewelry by jewelers.

name: Amethyst Ore
description: A rare energy ore capable of charging time-space devices.

name: Knight's Medal
shape: Golden round medal with a star/sunburst design and green gems
description: A medal worn on the chest of a certain knight, representing precious honor.

name: Frostberry Jam
shape: A glass jar filled with dark purple jam/berries
description: Berries growing in the frozen land. Consuming them grants resistance to fire.

name: Wind Strike Ring
description: A ring that controls the wind element. Even those who cannot use magic can easily conjure Wind Blades with it.

name: Thunder Ore
description: A rare ore containing thunder power, used for crafting Lightning Equipment.

name: Space-Time Dust
description: Dust scattered from Chronorifts, slightly distorting space.

name: Mecha Core Shard
description: The core part of high-level machinery, driving precision mechanisms.

name: Molten Ore
description: A crystal from the depths of a volcano, containing frenzy flame energy.
